name: SLX low clamp front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 136.5 g for FD-M7000-10-L, 3×10-speed, side swing, 34.9 mm low clamp band, without S/M reducer adapters. The table explicitly defines band-type average weights at L size; its mount rows identify the unadapted 34.9 mm band. Other mounts and model variants do not inherit this weight.
